caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock with an ornate design placed centrally inside a larger outlined rectangle. The clock has three main sections: the top portion features a square clock face with Roman numerals and two hands, the outer part of the dial ring is yellow while the center is gray. Above the clock face is a carved wooden crest with an eagle design. The middle section contains a circular painted scene showing several figures in front of a house, surrounded by a decorative gilt frame with fruit and foliage in red, gold, and green. The lower section consists of a black glass panel framed in red with a smaller yellow and gold rectangular border; this panel contains the name "C. & L.C. IVES, BRISTOL CONN." and the image of a pendulum bob above the text. The frame of the clock is reddish-brown with simulated wood grain, and the vertical sides are decorated with carved columns featuring leaf patterns. The clock stands on four small gold feet. To the left of the main image, there is a smaller schematic illustration of the side view of the clock, drawn in simple lines, showing the depth and structure of the case along with a depiction of the pendulum. The overall composition of the image is orderly, with the colored rendering of the clock as the primary focus and the schematic drawing providing additional detail.
title: Mantle Clock
